seoTitle: Elevator Pitch Generator From Problem, Solution and Audience
metaDescription: Fill in who you help, the problem and your solution to get two pitch drafts with word count and speaking time. Free, private.
intro: Builds pitch drafts in a problem-first and a positioning-statement structure from a few fields.
why:
A short pitch states who you help, what hurts, what you do and why it is different. Writing each part separately makes gaps obvious: if you cannot fill the problem, the pitch will not land.

The tool fills two templates and shows a word count and speaking time at a relaxed pace. These are drafts to edit by ear, not finished copy. It does not use AI.
howTo: Fill in who, the problem and how you solve it.
Add what is different, proof and an ask if you have them.
Read the two drafts aloud and edit them.

faq.q: How long should a pitch be?
faq.a: Around 30 seconds, about 75 words, is typical.
No. It fills templates with your words.
A format: for a target who has a need, the product is a category that gives a benefit, unlike alternatives.
